fact: Decreto-Lei n.º 47/2022, published in Boletim Oficial n.º 111 of 24 November 2022, sets the guarantee of interoperability between public administration information systems as a basic principle for ICT investments and makes a prior opinion from the DNME, with NOSi, compulsory for ICT purchases of 2,000,000 escudos or more.
title: Aquisição de bens e serviços no domínio das TICs na AP passa a estar vinculada ao dever de informação e do parecer prévio
